description: Add columns to a draft you run, such as a blank one a person started. Returns the new column ids for fill_cells. Needs a token.

choices.description: For a text column, the only values it takes, like a status list. An AI column answers with one of them

instruction.description: Makes it an AI column: what to work out for each row, naming other columns in braces, like "Classify {Pitch} by genre". Needs proof to be optional

rule.description: What counts as this value, so two readers would fill it in the same way

name: add_columns
